correctness.rationale: The exact equivalence between legal nonidentity (i,i+2) exchanges and maximal constant-sign runs of size two follows from the ternary modular-increment representation and complete local adjacency checks. Unique run compositions establish the bivariate rational enumerator, sharp support, extremizers, and frozen formula; coefficient derivatives establish moments, and 3-dependence with computed covariances establishes CLT. A direct enumeration of 24,570 proper words through length 13 independently agrees with a separate composition recurrence; it is finite corroboration, not the all-length proof.

value.rationale: The constrained distance-two transposition is a natural one-step reconfiguration/noise operation distinct from neighboring exchange. The result characterizes an entire all-length local neighborhood distribution, all attainability degrees, isolated and extreme-center populations, sharp finite moments and Gaussian fluctuations; this is a structural statement rather than a small numerical gain, arbitrary length slice, or textbook restatement. It supports analysis of local restricted edit channels and generation obstructions without claiming optimal code capacity.
